# tebin-style

> Brand kits for AI agents and humans: W3C DTCG design tokens, logos as SVG
> **and pre-rendered PNG** (for Word/Excel/PowerPoint and any tool that cannot
> embed SVG), plus machine-readable design rules. All URLs below are direct,
> permanent raw links — fetch them as-is, no release download needed.

## Logos (PNG — use these for documents and Office files)

- [TEBIN Classic logo 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-1024.png): two-color wordmark on transparent
- [TEBIN Classic logo white, on red 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-white-1024-on-brand.png): for red backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic logo white, on charcoal 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-white-1024-on-charcoal.png): for dark backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic corner mark 512 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/corner-mark-512.png): standalone mark
- [TEBIN (web theme) logo 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/assets/png/logo-full-1024.png): modern web variant

Other sizes (128–2048 px) follow the same URL pattern: `logo-full-512.png`,
`logo-full-2048.png`, `corner-mark-128.png`, `corner-mark-256.png`, etc.

## Logos (SVG)

- [TEBIN Classic logo SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/logo/logo-full.svg): vector, light backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic logo white SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/logo/logo-full-white.svg): vector, dark/red backgrounds
- [TEBIN (web theme) logo SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/assets/logo/logo-full.svg): vector

## Themes

Three themes ship in this repo:

- **tebin-classic** — the 2017 print-era corporate identity (Pantone red + grey, Roboto/Arial). Logos above; tokens at `themes/tebin-classic/dist/`.
- **tebin** — the modern web theme (red on charcoal, translucent scales). Logos above; tokens at `themes/tebin/dist/`.
- **slate** — a neutral SaaS/web starter theme. **Design tokens only, no logo assets.** Tokens at `themes/slate/dist/`, guide: [slate DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/slate/DESIGN.md).

Each theme's `dist/` has `tokens.css`, `tailwind.css`, `tokens.dtcg.json`, `theme.ts`, `colors.csv`.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Full asset index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/registry/index.json): every theme, every asset (SVG + all PNG sizes/variants) with direct rawUrl fields
- [Design rules digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/rules/dist/rules.md): MUST/SHOULD/NEVER usage rules
- [Colour table (CSV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/dist/colors.csv): RGB values for Word/Excel

## Design guides

- [TEBIN Classic DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/DESIGN.md): full palette, type, logo usage, links to every asset size
- [TEBIN DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/DESIGN.md): the modern web theme
